OpenCode Status settings

Configure the OpenCode server and choose where Pebble sends messages.

Important: Prompts may modify files or run commands through the configured agent. HTTP sends your password and pairing tokens in cleartext; use HTTPS or a trusted encrypted network.

Server connection

Plugin not ready Disconnected

No saved connection.

Connect with password

Password is used for connection setup, stored securely by the plugin, and never returned to this page.

Connect with pairing link

Run opencode pair, copy the printed link, and paste it here. The link is single-use and expires after 5 minutes. Paste it directly; do not open it in a browser first.

Message destination

For each message

New sessions require an absolute server directory. This applies to untargeted messages; explicitly targeting a session takes precedence.

Message delivery

Queue waits for the current run to finish; steer injects at the next safe turn. An action delivery argument overrides this setting.

Recent replies

The replies source returns this many recent sessions. Each poll makes one request per session. Range 1-20.

Reply notifications

Off by default. Notifications do not include reply text or session titles. Bundled apps can offer an Open reply action.

Recent sessions

Titles can repeat. Directory and default markers help distinguish sessions.

Select edits nickname only. Use as default saves the message destination.

No default session selected.

    Connect to load sessions.

    Up to 40 characters. Spoken targets can be ambiguous; choose distinct nicknames.

    Watch preferences

    These settings apply to OpenCode Status on the watch. They are saved separately from the plugin connection and message settings above.

    Plugin polling

    Plugin default uses the OpenCode plugin's own refresh intervals.

    Show only active or action-needed

    Hides read or idle sessions. Running sessions, unread replies, questions, and permission requests stay visible.

    Mark read after

    On app load, unread replies older than this are marked read automatically. Permission and question requests are never dismissed.

    Subagents

    Choose how subagents appear in the watch list.

    Number and Hide also hide subagent questions and permission requests from the watch list. They are not forwarded to the parent session. Open OpenCode on your phone or computer to respond.

    Number requires an updated OpenCode plugin that exposes parent and root session IDs.

    Canned replies

    One per line, up to 8. Short-press Select on a reply to choose one; long-press to dictate.
